Inglewood, California
  September 29, 2020

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, September 29, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

MAYOR PRO TEM APPOINTMENT. It was moved by Council Member
Franklin, and seconded by Council Member Padilla that the City Council does
hereby appoint Council Member Morales as Mayor Pro Tem for Closed Session.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Franklin;
Noes:  None; and
Absent:  Mayor Butts.

Mayor Pro Tem/Successor Agency Chairman Pro Tem Morales called the City
Council/Successor Agency into Closed Session at the hour of 1:00 p.m.
The Acting City Clerk/Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:
  Present:  Council Members/Successor Agency Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Franklin, and Mayor Pro
  Tem/Successor Agency Chairman Pro Tem
  Morales; and
  Absent:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman Butts.
City/Successor Agency officials and personnel present for closed session were as
follows:

  Aisha Thompson  Acting City Clerk/Secretary
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel

any persons present who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency on
any Closed Session Item.

There was no response.

Council/Successor Agency at the hour of 1:01 p.m., for Closed Session Item Nos.
CS-1 & CSA-1, and CS-2.
